Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Reyda wrote:
>
> "Orpheus" <orph...@wanadoo.fr> wrote in message
> news:a6knbk$qeq$1...@wanadoo.fr...
> > What if you borrow a minion "until the end of your turn" (Mind Rape,
> > Puppeteers...) and get him killed ? When it dies, it was yours, so does it
> > end in your ash heap or in the former controller's ?
> >
>
> his owner's ash heap, as for all temporary control effects =)

Correct. Also true for permanent control effects.
Cards that go to ash heaps (or libraries or crypts for that matter)
always go to their owners' ash heaps (or whatever). [1.1.2]

Other people's cards go to their owner's ash-heaps, regardless of who
controlled them. [1.1.2]
